headlines.text: Turning the clock back to 2025: history was made as Kazuchika Okada vs. Kenny Omega contested the very first AEW Unified Title match, appearing on All In: Texas, rated 8.60 ? a stone-cold classic. In the inaugural Unified Championship match, Okada hit the Rainmaker to defeat Omega, tying their legendary series at 2-2-1.

On a Wednesday in 2023, back when Nick Wayne made a statement, debuting in the main event against Swerve Strickland, appearing on Dynamite, rated 7.54 ? a well-paced, entertaining battle. Fresh off turning 18 the day before, the third-generation prodigy made his AEW debut against Swerve Strickland, pushing him to the limit before falling to the JML Driver ? a performance that got him signed on the spot.

2025 brought us this moment: a new champion was crowned for the AEW World Heavyweight Title as Adam Page vs. Jon Moxley battled it out in a Texas Death Match, appearing on All In: Texas, rated 9.62 ? a five-star epic ? ending the champion's reign at 8 defenses. In a chaotic Texas Death Match main event featuring interference from Bryan Danielson, Darby Allin, Swerve Strickland and Will Ospreay, Page forced Moxley to tap to a chain choke, ending the Death Riders' hold on the AEW World Title.

secondaries.text: On a Saturday in 2025, back when Toni Storm vs. Mercedes Mone fought tooth and nail for the AEW Women's World Title, appearing on All In: Texas, rated 8.84 ? an incredible outing. It was the 70th time the AEW Women's World Title had been on the line, a genuinely rare milestone for that title. Storm hit an avalanche Storm Zero to retain the AEW Women's World Title, handing Mon? her first-ever one-on-one loss in AEW.

Looking back to 2025, when there was a changing of the guard for the AEW TNT Title as Dustin Rhodes vs. Daniel Garcia vs. Kyle Fletcher vs. Sammy Guevara battled it out, appearing on All In: Texas, rated 4.97 ? ending the champion's reign at 4 defenses. Daniel Garcia was chasing gold for the 10th time. With Adam Cole forced to vacate the TNT Title over a health issue, Rhodes rolled up Garcia in a four-way also involving Fletcher and Guevara to win the vacant championship.

2025 brought us this moment: Syuri made their first appearance under the AEW banner in a Casino Gauntlet match against Athena vs. Alex Windsor vs. Julia Hart vs. Kris Statlander vs. Megan Bayne vs. Mina Shirakawa vs. Queen Aminata vs. Tay Melo vs. Thekla vs. Thunder Rosa vs. Willow Nightingale, appearing on All In: Texas, rated 7.56 ? a strong outing. Syuri competed in the record-breaking 20-plus-entrant Women's Casino Gauntlet, ultimately won by Athena in a match that reshaped the entire women's title picture.
